name: What is the difference between a freestanding and a wall-mounted bathroom vanity?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a freestanding and a wall-mounted bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freestanding vanities sit directly on the bathroom floor, often resembling a piece of furniture, and are generally easier to install as they don't require wall reinforcement. Wall-mounted (or floating) vanities are secured to the wall, leaving the floor underneath open, which can create a more modern look and make cleaning the floor easier. However, wall-mounted units often require stronger wall support. When choosing, consider both the aesthetic you desire and the structural requirements of your bathroom walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Freestanding vanities sit on the floor; wall-mounted vanities are secured to the wall, offering different aesthetics and installation considerations.
